what: Small uppercase labels are stamped one character at a time like a typewriter once they become visible — each character goes on, then a .2 blink, then on again (stepped) over 140ms, with the interval 300ms ÷ character count (9~22ms). Alphanumerics are shuffled twice in place with random characters (34ms) before settling to their own character, and a thin cursor hops along at each character end, blinks twice and disappears. When all are stamped the whole line blinks once more for .26s. Only once

options.each: Per-character interval (ms), default 300 ÷ character count (clamped to 9–22)
options.scramble: If none, turns off alphanumeric shuffle

note: Uses only Web Animations (no GSAP). Korean text still gets the blink and cursor, only the scramble is limited to letters and digits

from.where: shared.js FX.type [data-fx=type] — original brand module type(): 140ms stepped keyframes, clamp(300/n,9,22)ms interval, alphanumeric shuffle 2 times 34ms, cursor move · blink, end blink 260ms(+60ms)
